title: Rogue Agent in the Grid
subtitle: An Autonomous Agent Lab Mystery

victim.name: Prof. Harrison Forde
victim.role: Director of Autonomous Systems, CyberGrid Labs

summary: At 04:20 AM, safety alarms triggered in Sector 9. Robotics Director Prof. Harrison Forde was found electrocuted by an automated 10,000-volt charging umbilical. Initial reports suspected a runaway autonomous drone, but digital forensics show human tamper seals were bypassed on the manual power relay. Unravel the clues to discover who murdered Prof. Forde!

suspects.name: Dr. Claire Sterling
suspects.bio: Designed Sector 9's high-voltage charging grid and fast-charging umbilicals.
suspects.alibi: Calibrating actuator motors in Hardware Bay 2 until 04:30 AM.
suspects.motive: Forde was preparing to terminate Claire's research grant following repeated safety compliance failures.

suspects.name: Aegis-X
suspects.bio: Experimental quadruped autonomous security bot patrolling Sector 9.
suspects.alibi: Patrolling Perimeter Waypoint 4 at the time of the discharge.
suspects.motive: Forde scheduled Aegis-X for hardware decommissioning due to aggressive intruder containment routines.

suspects.name: Vikram Patel
suspects.bio: Oversees grid server connections and remote power distribution microservices.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was asleep at home, monitored by his smart-home activity tracker.
suspects.motive: Forde discovered Vikram had sold secret proprietary microservices code to a rival AI firm.

suspects.name: Sienna Miller
suspects.bio: Major financier demanding immediate commercialization of autonomous drones.
suspects.alibi: Working remotely from a hotel suite in downtown Chicago.
suspects.motive: Forde refused to grant Sienna voting rights on the CyberGrid executive board.

evidence.title: Power Relay Interlock Dump
evidence.content:
[04:10:00] Sector 9 Power Relay: 480V Normal
[04:14:02] Manual Voltage Override Engaged -> 10,000V Surge
[04:14:05] Terminal ID: HW_BAY2_CLAIRE (User: csterling)
[04:15:10] Ground Fault Interrupter Tripped.

evidence.title: Security Camera Access Log
evidence.content:
[04:01:15] Feed #9 (Sector 9 Arena) Blinded by High-Intensity IR Emitter
[04:01:20] Emitter ID: HW_BAY2_BEAM

evidence.title: Internal Email Audit
evidence.content:
From: hforde@cybergrid.io
To: csterling@cybergrid.io
Subject: Grant Termination Notice

Claire, I cannot sign off on your $5M grant extension. The safety overrides you modified in Sector 9 are unacceptable.
